evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Matched grammatical structure ('A rollback we have not X' / 'a rollback we do not Y') sets rehearsed vs. not-actually-have in deliberate opposition — parallelism doing antithesis work.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here crystallized into matched opposed clauses that make the contrapositive feel self-evident?
